agent_notes: Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy's exact local self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to confirmed search and official IIT Kanpur hosts.
The official contact page identifies the single campus at Kalyanpur, Kanpur 208 016; the district is recorded as Kanpur Nagar for this Kanpur campus.

The catalogue was established from the official undergraduate and postgraduate catalogue pages, supplemented by the current 2026 PG-admissions page, WSAIS programme page, and official IIT Kanpur Online Programmes pages.
The official eMasters page states that there are no future admissions to the eMasters programme, so it was excluded as inactive; short-term news and events were excluded.
Dual-degree options and the B.Cyber certificate/diploma exit awards are included because the official catalogue explicitly lists them as programme or exit credentials.
